subject: general
question:
There is a spelling error in the given sentence. Select the option that contains the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

As per manager’s opinion, the laser sprinkler malfuntioned.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"malfuntioned"** is incorrectly spelt. It should be **"malfunctioned".** (गलत तरीके से काम करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The device **malfunctioned **during the test run.
 
 
 
• **"Malfunctioned"** means failed to function properly. (खराबी आना)
 
 
• **Example:** The machine **malfunctioned **and had to be repaired immediately.
 
 

Hence, the correct spelling is '**malfunctioned.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sprinkle** (छिड़कना): To scatter or distribute small particles of a substance.

 
 
• **Example:** She likes to **sprinkle **sugar on her cereal.
 
 
 
• **Laser** (लेज़र): A device that generates an intense beam of coherent monochromatic light or other electromagnetic radiation.
 
 
• **Example:** The surgeon used a** laser** to perform the operation.
 
 
 
• **Opinion** (राय): A belief or assessment based on grounds short of proof; a personal view.
 
 
• **Example:** In my **opinion,** this is the best solution to the problem.
 
 

1fb:Tb4c,

The correct answer is** Option 2)**
